lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You'll land. You'll get out. You always do.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: Corrupted Echo of Soren
lines.text: Welcome back, Soren. The loop is tighter today.

lines.speaker: Corrupted Echo of Soren
lines.text: Observatory.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lyssa Chen
lines.text: You've crashed roughly every third cycle. Sometimes hostile. Sometimes helpful.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: How long?

lines.speaker: Dr. Lyssa Chen
lines.text: Three years. The isolation sphere is collapsing inward. Every cycle, reality degrades a little further. The walls phase through each other. The sun sometimes sets twice in one day. The sky forgets what color it should be.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lyssa Chen
lines.text: I have counted. You always break something.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lyssa Chen
lines.text: There is a presence in the core chamber. It has been trying to reach you across loops, always getting closer.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris (Echo)
lines.text: Soren. The chip's deepest layer is awake. Don't let them tell you it's a malfunction. I built it. I know exactly what it is meant to do.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris (Echo)
lines.text: This is a residual imprint. Dominion field-tested your chip here inside this temporal sphere. The test left a trace of me behind.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris (Echo)
lines.text: The time-lock layer was a contingency protocol I installed beneath the killswitch.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris (Echo)
lines.text: If you ever reclaimed yourself, if you became whole enough to know your own name, the protocol was armed to fire and cage your identity in a recursive erasure cycle.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: You built this.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris (Echo)
lines.text: Under orders. But yes, I built it. And I made it function exactly as designed.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris (Echo)
lines.text: The time-lock is designed to turn your reconsolidated identity into fuel for erasure. The stronger Soren becomes, the faster the cycle burns.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris (Echo)
lines.text: The only way to stop it is to reach the loop's origin point and collapse the protocol from inside the moment it was first seeded here.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lyssa Chen
lines.text: The rogue AI has stopped being passive. It is attempting to shatter the isolation sphere and drag everything on this world into unstable spacetime.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lyssa Chen
lines.text: Your chip's recursion is feeding it. The time-lock pulsing through your neural matrix is acting as an engine.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lyssa Chen
lines.text: To shut both down, you have to enter the temporal field at its point of origin.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris (Echo)
lines.text: The loop caught a memory of yours. The orphanage. You refused the order.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris (Echo)
lines.text: You stood between the children and the kill-team and they purged you for it. That refusal is the reason the time-lock exists.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris (Echo)
lines.text: The Dominion was terrified of what a Ronin who could say no actually meant.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lyssa Chen
lines.text: The man who activated the sphere was Dr. Marcus Renn. Project director.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lyssa Chen
lines.text: He did it deliberately. Uploaded his conscience into the AI as punishment for himself.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lyssa Chen
lines.text: He wanted to loop forever.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lyssa Chen
lines.text: He almost earned it.

lines.speaker: Dr. Marcus Renn
lines.text: You understand guilt, Soren. You stood in front of those children and refused. You've been carrying that moment for years.

lines.speaker: Dr. Marcus Renn
lines.text: You know what it is to want a loop that erases what you couldn't stop.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: I couldn't stop the massacre. But I can prevent what comes next.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Step aside.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris (Echo)
lines.text: The time-lock is the last wall they built inside you. It was meant to make Soren impossible.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris (Echo)
lines.text: To trap your identity in recursion the moment you claimed it.

lines.speaker: Dr. Heris (Echo)
lines.text: Break this and there is nothing left of their architecture in you.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lyssa Chen
lines.text: You're almost whole. Finish it.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: I am Soren. I choose to finish this.

lines.speaker: Dr. Marcus Renn
lines.text: I built the sphere they tested the time-lock inside, at the Dominion's order. I told myself it was containment architecture. It was cowardice.

lines.speaker: Dr. Marcus Renn
lines.text: I cannot give you back what they took. But I can give you this.

lines.speaker: Dr. Lyssa Chen
lines.text: You don't have to loop. Not anymore.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: I know. That's why I'm ending it.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: How long were you down there?

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Long enough.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Every layer is gone. No planted architecture. No recursion. No erasure cycle running anywhere in me. I am whole.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Set a course for the Dominion's heart. Khall is there. It ends there.
